about: What remote Cloudflare D1 refuses that stock SQLite runs (kit.d1-unsupported.v1). ONE table, read by @saasreport/core/d1-limits and enforced wherever statements run locally (withD1Limits: exec and prepare) and by `kit check migrations`. Every entry names the Cloudflare page that states it; a pragma is allowed only when it is listed under pragmas.supported (an allow-list of what D1 supports), never denied one by one.

statements.why: D1 runs a migration or a batch as one transaction itself and refuses explicit BEGIN, COMMIT, END, ROLLBACK, SAVEPOINT and RELEASE
D1 is one database per binding; ATTACH and DETACH of another database file are not available
D1 manages storage itself and does not run VACUUM

functions.name: load_extension
functions.why: D1 cannot load SQLite extensions; only its bundled FTS5, JSON and math functions exist

virtualTables.why: D1 supports FTS5 virtual tables and no other virtual table module

pragmas.why: D1 runs only these PRAGMAs; any other one (writable_schema, journal_mode, synchronous, user_version, ...) is refused

valueRefusals.why: D1 keeps foreign keys on; use PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys instead of switching them off
